articles.title: “Disabled Court Employee’s Tragic Death at Saket Court | Note Cites Work Pressure & Mental Distress
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic incident was reported from Saket Court, Delhi, where a differently-abled court employee, Harish Singh Mahar, allegedly died by suicide.

body.html:
A tragic incident was reported from Saket Court, Delhi, where a differently-abled court employee, Harish Singh Mahar, allegedly died by suicide. Police recovered a handwritten note in which he cited extreme work pressure, prolonged mental distress, sleeplessness, and financial anxiety linked to retirement. In his final appeal, he urged authorities to ensure dignity and humane working conditions for persons with disabilities. Investigation is underway.

articles.title: Mother of Three Leaves Family, Marries Cousin in Vaishali; Husband Acts as Witness
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has surfaced from Bihar’s Vaishali district, where a mother of three allegedly left her husband and children and married her cousin, triggering widespread discussion in the region.

body.html:
A shocking case has surfaced from Bihar’s Vaishali district, where a mother of three allegedly left her husband and children and married her cousin, triggering widespread discussion in the region.

The woman, identified as Rani Kumari, a resident of Jandaha, was married to Kundan Kumar in 2011 through a court marriage. The couple has three sons, who will now live with their father. According to local accounts, Rani developed a relationship with Govind Kumar, her maternal uncle’s son, reportedly through social media over the past few years.

Family members said the man frequently visited her home, raising no suspicion due to their familial relationship. About a week ago, Rani suddenly went missing, prompting her husband to search for her and approach the police. It later emerged that Rani and Govind had married in a court ceremony. In a video message, Rani stated that she no longer wished to live with her first husband.

Notably, Kundan Kumar has claimed that Rani was unwilling to continue the marriage and wanted to live with Govind. He said he agreed to the separation and even acted as a witness during their court marriage.

Legal experts point out that marriage between close blood relatives is prohibited under the Hindu Marriage Act and may be considered void. Additionally, marrying again without legally dissolving the first marriage can attract criminal liability under the law. Leaving minor children without care may also invite legal scrutiny.

Police said the matter is being examined and further action will depend on the legal findings.

#VaishaliNews #BiharNews #SocialMediaImpact #FamilyDispute #CourtMarriage #BreakingNews

articles.title: Tragedy at IIT Ropar: 21-Year-Old Student Aditya Sagar Dies After Collapsing in Campus Gym
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur resident Aditya Sagar (21), a third-year B.Tech Civil Engineering student at IIT Ropar, died after collapsing during a workout at the institute’s campus gym in Rupnagar, Punjab. Aditya, who had recently registered at the gym, was visiting it for the first time on Monday evening.

body.html:
Hapur resident Aditya Sagar (21), a third-year B.Tech Civil Engineering student at IIT Ropar, died after collapsing during a workout at the institute’s campus gym in Rupnagar, Punjab.

Aditya, who had recently registered at the gym, was visiting it for the first time on Monday evening. Around 6:30 pm, while exercising, he reportedly began bleeding from his ear, sweated heavily, and collapsed. He was rushed to the IIT Medical Centre and later referred to the Civil Hospital, Rupnagar, where doctors declared him dead.

Police said the post-mortem has been completed. According to fellow students, Aditya had gone to the gym on an empty stomach and had no known medical history.

Aditya returned to campus on January 2 after New Year holidays. His family was informed by the institute administration. His father, Vineet Sagar, a DCP in the Railway Department currently posted in Patna, rushed to Ropar and reportedly fainted on seeing his son’s body. The body was brought to Hapur on Wednesday, where last rites were performed amid grief.

Vineet Sagar had earlier served in the security detail of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. The family resides in Avas Vikas Colony, Hapur. Aditya’s mother, Madhu Sagar, is a homemaker, and his younger brother, Arnav Sagar, is a law student in Raipur.

The IIT Ropar administration termed the incident an accident and expressed condolences. The campus gym is meant for light workouts and does not have professional trainers or physiotherapists.

Police said further inquiry is underway.

#IITRopar #StudentDeath #GymTragedy #HapurNews #EngineeringStudent #CampusSafety #BreakingNews

articles.title: Female Sub-Inspector Files Dowry Case, Husband Claims He Made Her an Officer #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A female sub-inspector posted at Hafizganj police station in Bareilly has filed a dowry harassment case against her husband and in-laws in Hapur, triggering sharp debate and counter-allegations.

body.html:
A female sub-inspector posted at Hafizganj police station in Bareilly has filed a dowry harassment case against her husband and in-laws in Hapur, triggering sharp debate and counter-allegations.

The accused husband, Gulshan, a resident of Pootha Hussainpur village in Hapur, claims the case is false and motivated. He alleges that he supported his wife, Payal Rani, during her studies and helped her clear competitive exams, following which she became a sub-inspector in 2023. Gulshan currently works as a daily wage labourer while preparing to join the Indian Army.

According to police, the couple met in 2016, had a court marriage in 2021, and later solemnised the marriage as per Hindu rituals on December 2, 2022, without dowry. After Payal’s posting in Bareilly, differences reportedly arose between the couple.

On November 13, 2025, Payal Rani submitted a complaint to the Hapur Superintendent of Police, alleging that her husband and in-laws demanded ₹10 lakh in cash and a car. She accused them of mental and physical harassment, assault, and threats.

Following the SP’s directions, Hapur Nagar police registered an FIR against Gulshan and six family members under dowry harassment and other relevant sections.

Hapur SP Gyananjay Singh said a case has been registered and the matter is under investigation. Statements from both sides are being recorded and evidence is being examined.

#DowryCase #UPPolice #HapurNews #Bareilly #LoveMarriage #DomesticDispute #BreakingNews
